title: Papa no Iukoto wo Kikinasai!: Pokkapoka
justification: AniList 12673 (SPECIAL, 1 episode from 2012-07-11) is AniDB 8686's special S1 Pokkapoka (Warmth), aired 2012-07-11. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 11179, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 8686, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji title (Pokkapoka) and the English synonym Warm Fuzzies / Warmth. The parent has no row for S1, so it lands on TVDB 0x1 [Not Broadcast] Warmth (2012-07-11) and on TMDB 46183 S0E1 Warmth (2012-07-11).
